findings.text: The skill states ICPDocuments.fetch(uid, version, storage_dir) but iter_codex/discovery/icp/documents.py:56 declares a required keyword-only expected_type: str, so an agent copying the call verbatim gets a TypeError. The gate cannot catch it because verify_skill.py inspects only MCP tool names and live schema properties.
The file ends without a trailing newline, while every existing skill file in .claude/skills ends with one.
The fragment ends without a trailing newline, unlike the other files in docs.

justifications.durability: No test in the repository fails if this change regresses: the guard is verify_skill.py in the run directory, which reads live-response JSON that does not travel with the repo, and the brief forbade a source or test change. The guard was nonetheless negative-controlled (gate-negative.log FAIL, EXIT=1 on the version mutation), which is why this is not lower.
justifications.evidence: The done_when is met: every cited tool, field and operator is traced in lucy-record-tools-skill.html:34-131 to a saved live response, and gate.log records tools cited 13 all in live list, all declared True, PASS, EXIT=0, over the saved tools-list.json and document-schema.json.
justifications.fit: The skill uses the directory-plus-SKILL.md form and the name/description frontmatter idiom of .claude/skills/archive-signals/SKILL.md:1-4, but both added files end without a trailing newline where every existing skill file ends with one.
justifications.goal_fidelity: All four brief deliverables are present: SKILL.md:1-10 carries a frontmatter name and a description naming ITER documents, signal lists, self-description documents, PBS/GBS nodes and IDM identities, and SKILL.md:20-42 routes each question to its own tool with the chat tool confined to a written answer.
justifications.reuse: No owner exists for the capability the skill documents: a search over .claude/skills, docs/ and AGENTS.md found no guide to Lucy's MCP record tools, and the only nearby capability, iter_codex/discovery/icp (client.py:33, records.py:1-6), is repository API code the skill cross-references rather than forks.
justifications.scope_discipline: The diff is exactly the two declared write paths and nothing else, consistent with the brief's documentation-only rule recorded at lucy-record-tools-skill.html:10-12.

notes: The reviewed run's manifest carries no baseline_suite or after_suite because the node is documentation-only and ran no test suite, so added_failure_count is 0 and added_failure_ids is empty by derivation from that absence rather than by omission.
